data_fields.name: zone_radius_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: radius attribute; -1 unlimited; >30 warns (not used for monster leash)

data_fields.name: spawntime_s
data_fields.donor_constant: spawntime attribute in seconds; min 10 s, max 86400 s

data_fields.name: type_chance_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: chance attribute percent; default 100/n; total capped at 100

best_idea: A zone is a list of spawn points, each holding at most one monster with its own timer, a presence gate that blocks only the points a player is near, and a per-check spawn cap.
decision_why: The shape (points with timers, one live monster per point, presence gate, per-check cap) fits row 23, but the donor's global leash radius and missing grace timer do not fit, so the leash radius becomes zone data and a grace timer is added.
acceptance: A server test with a zone of two points at 60 s spawntime: a player within 11 tiles of point A keeps A empty; A spawns at the first zone check after the player has been away for the grace time; no more than rateSpawn spawns happen in one zone check.
